fix(renderer): a view hands its checked SessionId to its registry and its click URLs, so no config can redeclare which session a bar reads or writes (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.k4k) (#721)

* fix(renderer): a view hands its checked SessionId to its registry and its click URLs, so no config can redeclare which session a bar reads or writes (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.k4k)

A state variable and every click URL now key by the session the view draws
for, carried on its source, instead of the session.id variable a config can
redeclare. An unbound view's session is pending, as its inputs are, so a
load probe starts no state-keyed source. The exception parse in the state
source is gone, and with it the re-parse on every state read and revision.

* fix(renderer): a view always draws for a session, so check's clicks name the session it fakes and no click falls back to an empty id (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.k4k)

check binds CHECK_SESSION, so a view source's session is a SessionId and
the empty-id fallback and the no-session branches in state reads and the
revision are gone. A test payload naming no session draws for the test's
own, from one helper. The unbound session's pending names its payload
path, and the no-mode-explosion marker returns to the state declaration.

* fix(renderer): the row ✕ reads the session from its registry, and a click's session is typed SessionId to its URL (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.k4k)
